campaigns.mutate.title: Mutate Campaigns
campaigns.mutate.description: Create, update, or remove campaigns (POST customers/{id}/campaigns:mutate). On create, public startDate/endDate (and legacy start_date/end_date) map to start_date_time/end_date_time (v23+). Optional containsEuPoliticalAdvertising passes through as contains_eu_political_advertising and is never defaulted (advertiser declaration; upstream FieldError.REQUIRED if omitted on create). Mixed create/update/remove batch class — effect keys omitted; read back with campaigns.get.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID (hyphens optional). For MCC, pass the child account ID.

partialFailure.description: Allow partial success when some operations fail.

loginCustomerId.description: Optional MCC/manager customer ID for the login-customer-id header.

containsEuPoliticalAdvertising.description: Optional EU political advertising self-declaration for campaign create. Passed through as contains_eu_political_advertising. Use CONTAINS_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING or DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING. Never defaulted by the connector.

campaign.description: Normalized campaign; not populated by the mutate (mixed batches are not reconciled) — read back with campaigns.get.

resourceNames.description: Mutate resource names returned by the provider.
